We invite you to submit forecasts!

The NEON Ecological Forecasting Challenge is an open platform for the
ecological and data science communities to forecast data from [the
National Ecological Observatory Network](https://www.neonscience.org)
before it is collected.

The Challenge is hosted by the [Ecological Forecasting Initiative
Research Coordination Network](https://ecoforecast.org) and sponsored by
the U.S. National Science Foundation.

## Why a forecasting challenge?

Our vision is to use forecasts to advance theory and to support natural
resource management. We can realize this vision by creating and
analyzing a catalog of forecasts from many ecological systems,
spatiotemporal scales, and environmental gradients.

Our forecasting challenge is a platform for the ecological and data
science communities to advance skills in forecasting ecological systems
and generate forecasts that contribute to a synthetic understanding of
patterns of predictability in ecology. Rewards include skill
advancement, joy, and potential involvement in manuscripts. We do not
currently crown winners nor offer financial awards.

The Challenge is [an excellent focal project in university
courses](use-in-course.qmd#sec-in-class).

<br /> <br />

```{r setup}
#| include: false
source("R/setup.R")
library(bslib)
library(bsicons)
stats <- jsonlite::read_json(data_file("stats.json"))
years <- as.numeric(as.Date(stats$targets_end) - as.Date(stats$targets_start)) / 365
```

```{r}
layout_column_wrap(
  width = "250px",
  value_box(
    title = paste("Total forecasts submitted to the", cfg$project_id, "Challenge"),
    value = format(stats$n_forecasts, big.mark = ","),
    showcase = bs_icon("graph-up"),
    theme = "success"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "Most recent data for model training",
    value = stats$targets_end,
    showcase = bs_icon("bullseye"),
    theme = "info"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "Number of years of data for model training",
    value = round(years, 2),
    showcase = bs_icon("bullseye"),
    theme = "info"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "Number of variables being forecasted",
    value = stats$n_variables,
    showcase = bs_icon("clipboard-data"),
    theme = "success"
  )
)
```

<br /> <br />

## The Challenge is a platform

Our platform empowers you to contribute by providing target data,
numerical weather forecasts, and tutorials. We automatically score your
forecasts using the latest NEON data. All forecasts and scores are
publicly available through cloud storage and discoverable through our
catalog.
